title: Normalized scalar transport for the field-action equivalence
statement: Given fields $k\subset k^s$, the Krull group $G$, commutative condensed rings $R,R'$ and $\varphi:R\to R'$, and normalized field data $e_R,e_{R'}$ as in [def-sfb-field-action-transport-data], define $\mathrm{ScalarTransport}(\varphi,e_R,e_{R'})$ as follows. Restriction is the normalized scalar-action restriction of [lem-sfb-condensed-galois-global-descent], required exact, and ordinary extension is its additive left adjoint. Their adjunction square with ordinary scalar extension [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] on the field site and with ordinary condensed scalar extension preserves every Hom transpose. The field restriction comparison is identity on the normalized geometric sections and has the total-right-derived-unit normalization. Derived extension has a total-left-derived counit with its universal property in the unbounded categories of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]; its adjunction to exact restriction has counit equal to the transpose of the original ordinary scalar unit. Its squares with the field and forgotten scalar adjunctions have their exact restriction comparisons normalized by those ordinary comparisons. The derived scalar counit, adjunction and field-extension comparison preserve canonical shifts. This defines the type of compatible scalar data; it does not assert existence.
